title: Install Amendment B standing engineering policy authorization
problem: Normal engineering repeatedly stalls on per-change owner approval and exported personal sessions. The current renewable workload is valid but has metadata-only authority; it must not invent its own release grant.
expected_behavior: Release 9fa56e8824c3c258588880c6d288ff662b9baa80; manifest 88907173e82f0fc8e0bb3a8f3f22ac7da6c5a8cbe364064ae26fa91db13745a9. Install only the pinned Control/runtime and additive security migrations after the separately approved owner-session repair. Apply the frozen standing-policy declaration through the protected authenticated administrative installer after genuine owner approval. No further owner browser or per-change Controller approval is required for eligible routine work.
change_purpose: Implement the owner-directed permanent autonomous authority policy through legitimate, durable, scoped and revocable standing delegation.
feature_improvement: Automatically admit eligible routine releases using normal renewable workload Auth, exact source and CI, budget and scope checks, audit, component locks, rollback and independent source readback.
regression_rules: The executing workload cannot create or expand its own authority. Only the protected Management installer may apply the exact declaration already approved by the real owner.
Preserve every owner approval, revocation and execution event; never manufacture an owner Auth session or audit record.
Preserve V4 30, workspace 46, customer data, Gmail, email/WhatsApp/voice processing, memory ingestion and the existing pilot allowlist.
Preserve mandatory provider protections, CI, source verification, scoped permissions, idempotency and rollback.

Initial authority: existing bound engineering identity only; V4/workspace canary; low/normal risk; until revoked or the parent grant expires; at most ten releases/day; no new resource spending. Normal Auth sessions and release admissions remain short-lived.
acceptance_criteria: 196 composed tests, 31 isolated PostgreSQL assertions and five release-transport tests pass.
Verify the genuine owner approval and declaration digest before administrative provisioning; verify actual deployed source and grant revision afterwards.
Certify two unattended production cycles, expiry/revocation, target/risk/source denials and rollback before claiming operational autonomy.
Do not mark SANDY-ENG-0001 complete before all four channels and the required quality cohort pass.
